ms.criteria: (A) To determine the design specifications of the application system
ms.report:
We have make some meeting and discussion for the development of the voting result viewer system based on the UTXO Multi-address. Of course, we take into consideration the result of voting event at Milestone1. After this, we have decided the design specification of the application as following link. 
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1PQWw5-0t3PKCDOYWBcLzCzw0sJEQ41XS/view?usp=sharing
The summarized scope is as follows.
・ a list of voting events.
・ a list of voting targets and details.
・Display the score according to the vote.
Example : 
Voting number×1000＋ADA×500＋Token number
Note that after the voting period ends and a snapshot is taken, even if the UTXO changes, the voting results and score will not change.
・Administrators can do the following: 
 Set voting targets
 Address, Image, Define the score conversion formula
 Execute the process of taking a snapshot of the voting results
 Modify voter scores (not result control but for operations such as reward) 
 Voting Candidate can view their own voting results. 
 
by these achievement, the milestone 2 was achieved.

 3. Event Implementation: FC Tokushima MVP Voting
3.1 Event Overview
We implemented a player MVP voting event in partnership with FC Tokushima, a professional football club based in Tokushima Prefecture. The event was held at Tabino Otomo Café, an inclusive café employing persons with disabilities, located at Amico Building 5F, Tokushima City.
Event period: December 2025 – March 2026
 Primary voting period: February–March 2026 (concentrated activity after operational changes)
 Location: Tabino Otomo Café, Amico Building 5F, Tokushima City
 Total on-chain votes: 60
 Application used: https://voting-viewer.vercel.app/ja/events/sjbm4jht6h/entries
3.2 How the Event Worked
Voting targets (FC Tokushima players) were configured in the voting viewer application with their photos, names, and unique Cardano addresses. Participants visited the café, received ADA and Otomo tokens, and voted for their favorite player by sending a transaction to that player’s address.
